body:
The foundation `memmove(..., int)` overload competes with the CRT's `size_t` overload on 64-bit builds. Rename the checked helper to `imemmove`, delegate using `size_t`, and update its three integer-count calls in Md5 and Iff. Ordinary CRT calls retain the standard name.

The production change is three files, **+5/−5 lines**. Tests and CI are separate commits. This applies directly to `master`; it does not depend on the `64-bit-types` branch or PR #35. It mirrors [client-tools #25](https://github.com/SWG-Source/client-tools/pull/25), and either side can merge independently.

### Validation

- Linux32 and Linux64: **30 valid-buffer checks each**, plus compilation of the actual changed Md5.cpp and Iff.cpp translation units.
- Pinned upstream Linux32: the same 30 checks pass. Upstream Linux64 fails with exactly the two expected overload errors; additional, missing or unrelated errors fail the control.
- Native VS2013 Win32 and x64 Release: **30 checks each**, using exact repository headers. Fourteen text-only tests exercise the MSVC error classifier.
- The original source head `1481143ca4` also completed a clean **full legacy Linux32 build** in the pinned container: all 7,925 tracked inputs unchanged and all 20 inspected outputs ELF32. [Build log, command and limits](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/e515a78f54abf71bf677fd6f9e46dcc9ba662bfb/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/server-imemmove/full-build/RESULTS.md). Three existing Oracle `libaio.so.1` linker warnings are retained; those binaries were not run.
- [Hosted Linux CI passed on the original source head](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/src/actions/runs/36818778615), including the real callers and upstream controls. The added workflow repeats these checks on relevant pull requests and retains text evidence.

[Commands, hashes and native/compiler logs](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/4bf51e7275e61e2c4699c87ad7f121e8fbb7adc6/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/server-imemmove/RESULTS.md) · [Reproduction instructions](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/src/blob/1481143ca4f033ef979faff52a4d03bb8d636292/tools/test-imemmove/README.md)

The helper retains its Debug pointer checks and adds no length-range validation. These tests cover valid buffers, not invalid-input equivalence or initialized-engine Debug behavior. The native Windows run builds the header probe, not a Windows server. Linux64 Iff compilation retains two warnings in unchanged code caused by master's legacy `uint32` definition; no platform-type, wire-format, full-server LP64 or gameplay claim is included here.

The earlier Linux regression job passed [on the upstream PR](https://github.com/SWG-Source/src/actions/runs/36819210363). Its original full-build job [failed before compilation](https://github.com/SWG-Source/src/actions/runs/36819210211), because the inherited workflow passed `SWG-Source/src` to `git clone` as a local path. That failure remains visible.

This revision includes the [workflow repair #38](https://github.com/SWG-Source/src/pull/38) and a manual qualification trigger in separate CI commits. Production and regression-test files are unchanged. The repaired workflow checks out the submitted head, uses the pinned legacy container and verifies tracked inputs after building.

[Full legacy Linux32 qualification](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/src/actions/runs/36901376480) passed at `12c98077c01c39674adc9b17bdcd1b3a57e82f80`, including the tracked-input integrity check. The updated upstream check is separate from this completed fork run.
